text:
Lithium, sodium and potassium are elements in Group I.
Statements about these elements are listed.
1
Lithium is more dense than sodium.
2
Sodium is more reactive than potassium.
3
They all conduct electricity at room temperature.
4
They all react with oxygen at room temperature.
Which statements are correct?
A
1 and 2
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
3 and 4
